scope: Original synthetic Opto-PING Rung 0 packages. Rungs 0A and 0B share tools and study bundles. Archive identities were verified against the 2026-08-01 project inventory and the CRCs of every file.
credit: PRAYCG directed the simulation design and successive tests. The original assistant-assisted development record identifies the returned packages. The Python projects listed per package are external dependencies.
distribution_review: The recovered packages contain project scripts, generated outputs and supporting material. The originals and their contemporary index do not give a package-wide redistribution license for this combination. The repository mixed-license notice covers specified categories of project material. This inventory publishes metadata and records the scope of the numerical replays.
